CScript.bloco:
Component {
                  Type          CScript
                  Name          "C-Script1"
                  Show          on
                  Position      [210, 110]
                  Direction     up
                  Flipped       off
                  LabelPosition south
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "DialogGeometry"
                    Value         ""
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "NumInputs"
                    Value         "7"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "NumOutputs"
                    Value         "2"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "NumContStates"
                    Value         "0"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "NumDiscStates"
                    Value         "2"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "NumZCSignals"
                    Value         "0"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "DirectFeedthrough"
                    Value         "[1 1 1 0 0 1 1]"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "Ts"
                    Value         "Ts"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "Parameters"
                    Value         "Ts, Kpzd, Kizd, Kpzq, Kizq, Ra, Vd0, Vq0"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "LangStandard"
                    Value         "2"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "GnuExtensions"
                    Value         "2"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "RuntimeCheck"
                    Value         "2"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "Declarations"
                    Value         "/*\t\n"
"\tReference:\n"
"\t\n"
"\t\"Current and Flux Regulation in Field-Weakening Operation\", \n"
"\tFernando Briz, Alberto Diez, Michael W. Degner, Robert D. Lorenz\n"
"\t\n"
"*/\n"
"\n"
"\n"
"#define\tIN_e_d\t\tInput(0)\n"
"#define\tIN_e_q\t\tInput(1)\n"
"#define\tIN_ws\t\tInput(2)\n"
"#define\tIN_y_d\t\tInput(3)\n"
"#define\tIN_y_q\t\tInput(4)\n"
"#define\tIN_yff_d\tInput(5)\n"
"#define\tIN_yff_q\tInput(6)\n"
"\n"
"#define\tOUT_yset_d\tOutput(0)\n"
"#define\tOUT_yset_q\tOutput(1)\n"
"\n"
"#define DS_Int_d DiscState(0)\n"
"#define DS_Int_q DiscState(1)\n"
"\n"
"struct Parameters {\n"
"\tdouble Ts;\n"
"\tdouble Kp_d;\n"
"\tdouble Ki_d;\n"
"\tdouble Kp_q;\n"
"\tdouble Ki_q;\n"
"\tdouble Ra;\n"
"};\n"
"\n"
"struct Constants {\n"
"\tdouble Kpi_d;\n"
"\tdouble Kpi_q;\n"
"    \n"
"\tdouble KpD_KpiD; \n"
"\tdouble KpQ_KpiQ;\n"
"};\n"
"\n"
"static struct Parameters P;\n"
"static struct Constants C;\n"
"\n"
"/* values passed from output to update call */\n"
"static double we, y_d, y_q;"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "StartFcn"
                    Value         "if (NumParameters != 8){\n"
"   SetErrorMessage(\"Number of parameters does not match.\");\n"
"   return;\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"P.Ts = ParamRealData(0, 0);\n"
"P.Kp_d = ParamRealData(1, 0);\n"
"P.Ki_d = ParamRealData(2, 0);\n"
"P.Kp_q = ParamRealData(3, 0);\n"
"P.Ki_q = ParamRealData(4, 0);\n"
"P.Ra = ParamRealData(5, 0);\n"
"\n"
"C.Kpi_d = P.Kp_d + P.Ki_d;\n"
"C.Kpi_q = P.Kp_q + P.Ki_q;\n"
"    \n"
"C.KpD_KpiD = P.Kp_d / C.Kpi_d; // good fixed-point quantity < 1\n"
"C.KpQ_KpiQ = P.Kp_q / C.Kpi_q; // good fixed-point quantity < 1\n"
"\n"
"DS_Int_d = ParamRealData(6, 0);\n"
"DS_Int_q = ParamRealData(7, 0);"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "OutputFcn"
                    Value         "double Kw_d, Kw_q;\n"
"\n"
"we = IN_ws * P.Ts;\n"
"\n"
"Kw_d = P.Kp_d * we;\n"
"Kw_q = P.Kp_q * we;\n"
"\t\n"
"y_d = IN_e_d * C.Kpi_d - IN_e_q * Kw_q + DS_Int_d;\n"
"y_q = IN_e_q * C.Kpi_q + IN_e_d * Kw_d + DS_Int_q;\n"
"\n"
"OUT_yset_d = y_d - P.Ra * IN_e_d;\n"
"OUT_yset_q = y_q - P.Ra * IN_e_q;"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "UpdateFcn"
                    Value         "#if 1\n"
"/* determine realizable references */\n"
"double den = we * we * C.KpD_KpiD * C.KpQ_KpiQ + 1;\n"
"\n"
"double Kc1_d = -we * C.KpD_KpiD * C.KpQ_KpiQ / den;\n"
"double Kc1_q = -Kc1_d;\n"
"\t\n"
"double Kc2_d = -C.KpD_KpiD / den;\n"
"double Kc2_q = -C.KpQ_KpiQ / den;\n"
"\n"
"double Kpep_d = Kc1_d*(IN_y_q - DS_Int_q) + Kc2_d*(IN_y_d - DS_Int_d);\n"
"double Kpep_q = Kc1_q*(IN_y_d - DS_Int_d) + Kc2_q*(IN_y_q - DS_Int_q);\n"
"\t\n"
"/* update integrators */\t\n"
"DS_Int_d = IN_y_d + Kpep_d;\n"
"DS_Int_q = IN_y_q + Kpep_q;\t\n"
"\n"
"#else \n"
"/* implementation w/o anti-windup */\n"
"we = IN_ws * P.Ts;\n"
"\n"
"double Kw_d = P.Kp_d * we;\n"
"double Kw_q = P.Kp_q * we;\n"
"\n"
"DS_Int_d += (P.Ki_d * IN_e_d - Kw_q * IN_e_q);\n"
"DS_Int_q += (P.Ki_q * IN_e_q + Kw_d * IN_e_d);\n"
"\n"
"#endif"
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "DerivativeFcn"
                    Value         ""
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "TerminateFcn"
                    Value         ""
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "StoreCustomStateFcn"
                    Value         ""
                    Show          off
                  }
                  Parameter {
                    Variable      "RestoreCustomStateFcn"
                    Value         ""
                    Show          off
                  }
                }
